title: Simple Encounter Turns Into Complete Chaos
description:
► Code Blue Cam Merch 
http://www.codebluecam.com/

On October 5, 2022, an officer was investigating an incident that had occurred at Houska Park in La Crosse, WI. While attempting to place the man under arrest, a large hostile crowd formed after noticing the officer’s use of force. Eventually, an uninvolved party intervened and tried to push the officer off of the man. 

Link on the incident with more video of the altercation: 
https://www.wxow.com/news/la-crosse-police-release-video-of-houska-incident/article_46b71034-5b00-11ed-b3f5-334882eb945a.html

The purpose of the featured content is to show the law enforcement interaction. It is NOT to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved. Today’s world is swarmed with politics and conversations that are often misleading about our law enforcement officers. We feel it is vastly significant and imperative to show these interactions in their respective environments to inform and educate the overall public.
